---
title: "Vignettes"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: "asis"
info <- tools::getVignetteInfo("sps")
invisible(file.copy(system.file("doc", package = "sps"), "./", recursive = TRUE))
vigs = info[, "PDF"]
# redirect doc/index.html to vignettes.html.
if (!"index.html" %in% vigs) {
  writeLines(
    "<script>location.href = location.href.replace(/\\/[^\\/]*$/, '') + '/../vignettes.html';</script>",
    "doc/index.html"
  )
}
# Clean up .R files.
invisible(file.remove(file.path("doc", setdiff(info[, "R"], ""))))
res <- sprintf("- [%s](doc/%s)\n", info[, "Title"], vigs)
xfun::raw_string(res)
```
